audit.why: K'Sante taking level 1 and level 6, Akali owning 3-5 and both item windows matches 52.84% Emerald+ over 1737 games and the disk chart. Chart untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes listed 'All Out online' as an early spike with no other timings.
audit.why: His lane spikes are two Ntofo Strikes stacks (the pull), Footwork's shield, and All Out at 6 on a 120s cooldown - not All Out generically.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes rebuilt around the two-stack pull and All Out at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Path Maker was never named in the full layer, and dontsFull[0] claimed his Q walls you.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes is a 3.5s line that pulls at two stacks; Path Maker is the charged knockback-stun on 14s at rank 1 and its damage is TRUE, so neither armour nor MR reads that trade. The wall-launch is All Out, not Q.
audit.corrected: Renamed the don't to the Q pull, added Path Maker's 14s and true damage to breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid, tradeGood, phases[1].why and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.why: All Out is 120/100/80. The 120s at rank 1 is what makes baiting it a plan rather than a slogan.
audit.corrected: winCon, breakdown.mid/cooldowns/trading, phases[5].why, dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d now carry 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing tied anti-heal to a specific ability.
audit.why: All Out grants him healing, so Grievous Wounds timing decides the extended fight.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now names All Out's healing and tells you to anti-heal before contesting it.

edits.before: He’s tanky — shroud his Q, Q-poke his early. Akali wins the All Out cooldown windows.
edits.after: He's tanky — shroud Path Maker, poke his early. Akali wins the All Out cooldown windows.

edits.before: Shroud his Q and poke his early. Track All Out before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud Path Maker and poke his early. Track All Out's 120s at rank 1 and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: K'Sante wins by landing All Out, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: K'Sante wins by stunning you with Path Maker, then turning resists into AD inside All Out.

edits.before: Q K'Sante at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q K'Sante at max blade range, E-dash the angle once Path Maker's 14s is burning, and shroud the return.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Respect K'Sante's All Out completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Q-poke on energy rhythm loses early: Ntofo Strikes is a 3.5s line that pulls you in at two stacks. Never stand for the second one — bank CS, not pride.

edits.before: Trade strictly around All Out: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Trade strictly around All Out (120s at rank 1): when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. Path Maker's damage is true, so MR misreads it.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. Poke when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — 120s at rank 1, his duelist mode. Poke while it is down. - Path Maker: 14s, and its damage is true, so no resistance reads that trade. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.
